meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual framing from lesson text, hardware/software illustrations, software-classification diagram, licensing/source sections and evaluation. Diagram labels were read from the source image rather than reconstructed from outside computer knowledge.
source_notes: Both uploaded Term III 2024 English and Tamil books were used.

The software-classification diagram contributes system-management, developing-software, general-purpose and specific-purpose categories that are poorly captured by OCR; only labels visibly present in the source image were used.

The printed matching section contains crossed pairings (for example MAC OS–Free/Open Source and LINUX–Geogebra). It is not treated as a reliable answer key; classifications are taken from the lesson and MCQ sections instead.

The English and Tamil editions differ in Evaluation Question 2: English asks for the correct open-source phrase, while Tamil asks for the correct pair of software types. Both are retained in their edition-specific contexts.
The lesson itself lists the generic phrase 'Operating System' among Free and Open Source examples. That source wording is preserved as printed rather than silently corrected.
